reason: 23 euros a litre is two to three times what I pay for Monin, and if I want something local and homemade I make my own syrups and rhums arrangés behind the bar for almost nothing. I might ask for the free sample out of curiosity, but I'm not adding a supplier for that price.
objection: Price, plus supply: Monin comes with the rest of my order and tastes the same every time. A small fermented producer, I don't know if it changes from batch to batch or if they'll run out in the middle of the season.
would_change_my_mind: A price close to 12-14 euros a litre with steady delivery guaranteed, and a tasting that shows me something I really can't make myself, that my customers ask for again.
